svg.title: Scratch-wound field with an enlarged detail of the wound edge
svg.desc: Left: simulated 1.6 × 1.1 mm field, 12 h after the scratch, 1876 nuclei, with a 240 × 180 µm box at the left wound edge. Right: the same box enlarged 6.5 times, linked corner to corner. 7 of 36 cells in the box are dividing (19%), against 3.7% more than 300 µm from the edge. Scale bars: 200 µm and 50 µm.
svg.text: 240 × 180 µm at the left wound edge: the same cells
